description: The source timestamp renderer allocated a new Intl.DateTimeFormat for every displayed timestamp. Repeated complete SSR runs produced a 2.41 GB resident-memory footprint despite a small JavaScript heap.

evidence.exactMarkupRegression: lib/dashboard/regime-v2-render.test.mjs: two locale cases compare prior source with the repaired component across all 12 deterministic outputs.

repair: Reuse one module-scope Intl.DateTimeFormat per supported locale (exactly ES and EN), preserving options, UTC timezone and rendered strings.
validationLimits: RSS reduction and exact SSR equality support the repair. The finite benchmark does not establish a production SLA or prove absence of every possible leak.
